answer: Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the raven binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. The wander explorer makes public the whole merge tree. Honest users pay that once, farms 6 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
